art_note: Flat-rendered product imagery lacks the sophisticated atmosphere and styling expected of a luxury house.
desc_en: Redefine the silhouette with fluid elegance. These flared trousers combine a mid-rise waist with an all-over print that introduces movement and sophistication. Designed for an immaculate presence, the structure flatters the figure with a seamless drape and subtle functional details. The composition prioritizes daily comfort without compromising a refined, modern aesthetic. A versatile piece for transitioning between moments of ease and polished occasions. Available made to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Redefine la silueta con una elegancia fluida. Este pantalón acampanado combina una cintura media con un estampado integral que aporta movimiento y sofisticación. Diseñado para ofrecer una presencia impecable, su estructura estiliza la figura con una caída impecable y detalles funcionales sutiles. La confección prioriza el confort diario sin comprometer una estética depurada y moderna. Una pieza versátil para la transición entre momentos de descanso y ocasiones refinadas. Disponible bajo pedido con envío a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· Composition: polyester and elastane
· Mid-rise waist
· Flared silhouette
· Two front pockets
· All-over print
· Hand wash or machine wash cold, do not bleach, tumble dry low, do not iron, do not dry clean
· Made to order and available with worldwide shipping
